name: brutus-simulator
description: Tick-deterministic Brutus (OSRS NPC 15626) simulator: headless engine with RSProx log-replay verification, plus a Three.js client.

scripts.build: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); if(!fs.existsSync('public/osrs-assets/manifest.json')) { const {execSync}=require('child_process'); try { execSync('npm run assets', {stdio:'inherit'}); } catch { console.log('Extracting prebuilt asset zip...'); execSync('node -e \"const fs=require(\'fs\'), {unzip}=require(\'fflate\');/* or your unzip command */\"'); } }" && tsc --noEmit && tsx src/assetBundle/check.ts && vite build
